weld.surprise: The genuine JOINT-surprise (reachable only from BOTH parents) is NOT that the bomb exists — the bomb's physical POSSIBILITY was implied by fission physics ALONE (W_A). The genuine joint-surprise is the TEMPO: a speculative 1938 laboratory phenomenon was industrialized into a deployed weapon inside a SINGLE WAR (~33 months Groves Sep 1942 -> Hiroshima Aug 1945) — a tempo neither parent predicts alone. Fission physics alone moved at 'peace-time bureau tempo' (the German Uranverein had the SAME physics and never consummated — the negative control); the war-state alone had no weapon to build and depended on the refugee physicists the Axis had expelled. The two together collapsed a multi-decade industrialization into ~33 months. STANDOUT SUB-SURPRISE: the German-bomb fear that PULLED the program was largely a PHANTOM (Einstein: 'had I known the Germans would not succeed... I would have done nothing') — the weld was pulled to consummation by a misplaced fear with a real driving force but a false object. META-SURPRISE (the inverse of QG): synergy AND consummation are BOTH high, but the consummation was driven by EXOGENOUS forcing (total war + a phantom enemy) NOT internal maturation — a weld can be crisis-PULLED to completion far faster than its internal logic allows, the exact opposite of QG's 90-year non-consummation. The surprise here lives in the (surprise x child) plane at high-child / medium-surprise, where QG lives at low-child / high-surprise.

discrepancies.confidence_impact: No impact on child.confidence (0.95). Establishes the second corner of the 2-D (surprise x child) plane.

discrepancies.what: MORAL/DECISION historiography: the orthodox view (the bomb ended the war, saved lives) vs the Alperovitz revisionist view (Japan was near surrender, threatened by Soviet entry; the bomb was dropped partly as 'atomic diplomacy' toward the USSR; the 1946 US Strategic Bombing Survey concluded Japan would have surrendered without it). A live, unresolved historiographic war.
sources_in_conflict: Gar Alperovitz, 'The Decision to Use the Atomic Bomb'
orthodox accounts (the bomb ended the war)
discrepancies.why_interesting: Engages the {meaning} frame far more than any physics specimen: this child is a MORAL/POLITICAL object, so its 'status' and even the valence of its consummation are observer- and era-relative — the same meaning-frame relativity QG showed for 'which child is winning', here for 'was the child's use justified'. -> shows frame_of_weld must engage {meaning} for any weld whose child is a weapon/policy object. Does not move child_confidence (the bomb exists and was used).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Child existence/use ~0.97; the VALENCE/justification ~0.5 (observer- and era-relative; placed in fuzzy_layer.frontier).

discrepancies.what: GERMAN-THREAT illusion: the fear of a Nazi bomb (the chief PULL/justification) was largely groundless — the Uranverein was de-prioritized by Speer in 1942, made a graphite-moderator error, and lost its talent to emigration; Einstein later said he would have 'done nothing' had he known.
sources_in_conflict: Wikipedia 'German nuclear program during World War II'
discrepancies.why_interesting: Forces a refinement on D4 external-events: a pull-event can have a REAL acting force (the fear genuinely drove the program) but a FALSE object (the enemy was a phantom). The 'mechanism' and the 'truth of the trigger' are SEPARABLE — an external_event needs to record not just direction+mechanism but whether the motivating belief was VERIDICAL. The most consequential false-belief-as-driver in the batch. -> motivates a forcing_events.veridical flag (gaps[3]).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: ~0.9 that the fear drove it; ~0.85 that it was misplaced (with honest residual uncertainty about how close Germany 'could' have come).

discrepancies.what: PRIORITY/CREDIT: the bomb is popularly attributed to Oppenheimer ('father of the atomic bomb') and to Einstein (via the letter), but Einstein did no technical work and called the letter his 'one great mistake'; Szilard conceived the chain reaction, drafted the letter, AND ran the petition against using the bomb; the ~130,000 mostly-anonymous workers (Calutron Girls, segregated Hanford laborers) built it without knowing what it was.
discrepancies.why_interesting: A re-attribution/credit tension analogous to Maxwell's 'named after the wrong node': the canonical names (Einstein, Oppenheimer) attach to a symbolic originator and an integrator, not to the conceiver (Szilard) or the mass labor that physically produced the child. -> suggests the actor model needs to distinguish SYMBOLIC carriers from PRODUCING inhabitants — and that compartmentalized mass labor is a genuine actor-class the people_0 layer omits (gaps[6]). Recorded as a credit dispute, NOT a structural reattribution of the object (so weld.reattribution stays empty).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Holds the popular attribution at ~0.5, the distributed reality at ~0.9.

discrepancies.what: DATE/ATTRIBUTION wobble on the letter->action lag: the Einstein-Szilard letter is dated 2 Aug 1939 but was not delivered to FDR until 11 Oct 1939 (by Sachs), and produced only a $6,000 committee that sat largely inert until 1941 — so the popular 'the letter started the Manhattan Project' is a ~2-3 year compression of a slow, near-dormant runway.
sources_in_conflict: the popular 'the letter started it' narrative
discrepancies.why_interesting: A clean example of the schema's 'when as an interval not a date' (R2) at the conception phase: the gap between when the weld was DRAWN (Aug-Oct 1939) and when it FIRED (late 1941, post-MAUD + post-Pearl-Harbor) is itself diagnostic — a ~2-year drawn-but-not-firing interval (recorded in dormancy_intervals + the lifecycle dormancy phase). Negligible on substance, but a textbook case for interval-dating the conception->firing lag.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Negligible on substance; the ~2-year drawn-but-not-firing interval is recorded at ~0.9.

forcing_events._comment: (D4) the EXOGENOUS-FORCING 'weather' layer — FIRST-CLASS and LOAD-BEARING here (the antithesis of Maxwell's empty forcing_events). The consummation tempo is attributed MAINLY to these external events. Note the signature D4 finding: a single event (Nazi persecution) has OPPOSITE directions on the two rival lineages, and a pull-event (German-threat fear) can have a real force but a FALSE object.
forcing_events.name: World War II / total-war mobilization
forcing_events.mechanism: Total war converted near-unlimited federal money, industrial capacity, secrecy, and conscripted manpower into a single directed goal, collapsing a multi-decade industrialization into ~33 months. The canonical war/PULL event — without it the weld stays in the slow 1939-41 committee phase indefinitely (the German program with the same physics never consummated).

forcing_events.name: Attack on Pearl Harbor (7 Dec 1941)
forcing_events.mechanism: US entry into the war converted latent urgency into total commitment; the 18 Dec 1941 S-1 meeting was 'pervaded by an atmosphere of enthusiasm and urgency'. The specific exogenous shock that FIRED the weld (the revival trigger from the drawn-but-not-firing runway).

forcing_events.name: Fear of a German atomic bomb (the Uranverein threat)
forcing_events.mechanism: Belief that Heisenberg's program was ahead converted a physics curiosity into a national-survival imperative; explicitly cited to justify the crash program (17 Jun 1942) and motivated the emigre scientists. CRITICAL framework-vs-record tension: the threat was largely ILLUSORY (Speer shelved the German effort in 1942) — the weld was pulled to consummation by a PHANTOM enemy (Einstein: 'had I known the Germans would not succeed... I would have done nothing'). A pull-event whose acting FORCE was real but whose OBJECT was a mirage.
forcing_events._veridicality_note: (gaps[3]) ~0.9 that the fear DROVE it; ~0.85 that the fear was MISPLACED. This event demonstrates the need for a forcing_events.veridical flag: direction+mechanism are real, the motivating belief is false.

forcing_events.name: Nazi racial persecution / the emigre exodus (1933 Civil Service Law; 1938 Anschluss)
forcing_events.mechanism: The Law for the Restoration of the Professional Civil Service (1933) and the Anschluss (Mar 1938) expelled Jewish and anti-Nazi physicists (Einstein, Szilard, Fermi via his Jewish wife, Teller, Wigner, Bethe, Frisch, Peierls, Bohr), who became the decisive expertise of the Manhattan Project. The SAME political force that STARVED the German weld FED the American one — a single event with OPPOSITE directions on the two rival lineages. The deepest D4 irony of the specimen.
forcing_events._lineage_relative_note: (gaps[4]) direction=both because it is LINEAGE-RELATIVE: PULL on the Allied lineage (the emigres became its substrate), SQUEEZE on the Axis lineage (talent exodus). A single event's direction is not global.

forcing_events.name: Soviet espionage / Klaus Fuchs leak (1942-1945) -> RDS-1 (Aug 1949)
forcing_events.mechanism: Fuchs and others passed implosion-bomb design across the secrecy boundary; Western estimates credit it with accelerating the Soviet bomb by ~18-24 months. PULLED the arms race into being / SQUEEZED the US nuclear monopoly out of existence. The exogenous event that converted a single weapon into a bipolar arms race.

forcing_events.name: Hiroshima & Nagasaki (6 & 9 Aug 1945) + the surrender of Japan
forcing_events.mechanism: Combat use publicly consummated the weld and locked in the nuclear age; also the locus of the largest MORAL discrepancy (orthodox 'ended the war' vs Alperovitz revisionist 'Japan near surrender, bomb aimed at the USSR'). A pull-event for the child's geopolitical hardening.
forcing_events._why_contested_note: ~0.95 on occurrence; the WHY is contested (see discrepancies: moral historiography).

forcing_events.name: Postwar federal-science-funding settlement (Bush 'Science—The Endless Frontier' Jul 1945 -> AEC 1947 -> NSF 1950)
forcing_events.mechanism: The wartime OSRD model was made permanent: sustained government funding PULLED a whole national-laboratory + university-research complex into existence, the template for Cold-War physics patronage. The weld's organizational form outlived its weapon.
